figures.caption: Figure 1: Linear state readout (SR) versus the base objective on four control tasks. Left: control success against training epoch (mean over seeds; shaded band spans the seed range); the annotation gives the convergence gain, averaged over the last three epochs. Right: the convergence gain against the base success at convergence, with a least-squares fit. The readout does not lower the asymptotic ceiling, and its gain increases as the base objective moves away from saturation (Pearson r = −0.91), consistent with an intervention acting on the on-manifold metric tax δ0.
